svg.title: DynaBARN: navigation among dynamic obstacles
svg.desc: In a 20 m by 20 m world, random points are sampled and a polynomial is fit through them to form an obstacle path; each path segment gets a sampled speed, so the obstacle speeds up and slows down. Many obstacles with easy or hard motion profiles make worlds of graded difficulty, and a ground robot drives from start to goal while avoiding them.

g.text: Fit a random polynomial path for an obstacle
Sample a speed for every path segment
The robot must reach the goal without collision
s ~ N(μ, σ²), μ ~ U[s_min, s_max]
RL is best overall; TEB nearly
